advice.opportunity: Dairy farming in Madurai with potential for value-added products like curd paneer and butter
advice.strengths: Access to local dairy farms, government incentives, and existing infrastructure
advice.weaknesses: Seasonal demand fluctuations and single-buyer dependency
advice.threats: Supply disruption due to seasonal demand and single-buyer dependency, as well as competition from other dairy providers
advice.competition: Other dairy businesses in the region may offer similar products or services
advice.pricing: Pricing will be based on market demand and supply conditions
advice.steps: Invest in modern dairy technology and infrastructure Develop partnerships with local milk societies and government bodies Promote seasonal demand management strategies
